neighbours.label: ' it' / ' is' in a temporal clause with 'it' as subject ('when it is', 'once it is', 'when it comes')
fire: Water the plant only when it is completely dry.
The soup tastes better once it is left to cool for a while.
Return the book to the shelf when it is no longer needed.
My phone gets warm whenever it is charging overnight.
The dough is ready to bake once it is doubled in size.
I always forget my umbrella when it is raining outside.
The paint looks darker when it is still wet on the wall.
Close the window before you leave if it is getting cold.
quiet: Water the plant only on Sundays and Wednesdays.
The soup tastes better with a little salt and pepper.
Return the book to the shelf after the lesson ends.
My phone gets warm whenever the battery charges overnight.
The dough is ready to bake after two hours in a warm room.
I always forget my umbrella during the rainy season.
The paint looks darker on the north side of the wall.
Close the window before you leave for the weekend.

notes: Top examples: 'when it comes', 'once it is properly sanitized', 'when it is directed', 'When it is light'. Probe: 'when it is needed' 0.54, 'when the guests arrive' 0.11, main-clause 'It is a beautiful day' 0.04.
